I’m always fascinated by fantasy worlds built on the remains of advanced civilizations. The latest of these is Splinters of Heaven by Theo Tsirigotis, a grimdark fantasy novel that exists in a “necro-industrial” world full of ancient magical artifacts and devices that litter the expanse of this world.
